terms.name: Backend
terms.definition: An AI model endpoint that processes queries.
terms.description: An AI model endpoint that processes queries.

terms.name: Backend Pool
terms.definition: The set of configured backends available for routing.
terms.description: The set of configured backends available for routing.

terms.name: Query
terms.definition: An incoming request to be routed to a backend.
terms.description: An incoming request to be routed to a backend.

terms.name: Classifier
terms.definition: Component that analyzes query content to determine complexity.
terms.description: Component that analyzes query content to determine complexity.

terms.name: Router
terms.definition: Component that routes queries to backends based on classification.
terms.description: Component that routes queries to backends based on classification.

terms.name: Log Entry
terms.definition: A record of a query's routing and execution metadata.
terms.description: A record of a query's routing and execution metadata.

terms.name: API Server
terms.definition: The entry point that receives incoming queries.
terms.description: The entry point that receives incoming queries.

terms.name: Config Loader
terms.definition: Component that reads and validates configuration files.
terms.description: Component that reads and validates configuration files.

terms.name: Local Backend Adapter
terms.definition: Adapter for communicating with local backends.
terms.description: Adapter for communicating with local backends.

terms.name: Cloud Backend Adapter
terms.definition: Adapter for communicating with cloud backends.
terms.description: Adapter for communicating with cloud backends.

terms.name: Query Status
terms.definition: Current state of a query (pending, routed, completed, failed).
terms.description: Current state of a query (pending, routed, completed, failed).

terms.name: Backend Status
terms.definition: Current availability of a backend (online, offline).
terms.description: Current availability of a backend (online, offline).

terms.name: Log Severity
terms.definition: Severity level of a log entry (info, warn, error).
terms.description: Severity level of a log entry (info, warn, error).

terms.name: Developer
terms.definition: Primary user who operates the CLI tool.
terms.description: Primary user who operates the CLI tool.

terms.name: User
terms.definition: An authenticated user account in the system.
terms.description: An authenticated user account in the system.
